verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents a Machines REST API for provisioning and managing Apps, Machines and Volumes, plus a full CLI (flyctl) and an experimental flyctl MCP server, so core infrastructure is scriptable. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers everything the UI does, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard root paths. missing for 10: evidence of explicit API/UI parity (e.g., org, billing, Managed Postgres and secrets management through the API), a discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on confirmation of full API coverage.
